fx ui · the space in full screen (in a terminal; Ctrl+Q closes it)

Usage: fx <command> [options]

Space
  init                                         Make this folder a space: its _fx/space.yaml, with its name, and nothing more.
  sync [<module>]                              Generate and update what fx owns here and in everything mounted below, from the _fx configuration.
  doctor [<module>]                            Check, without changing anything, that what fx owns here and below is right.
  mount list                                   The mounts of mounts.yaml: where, their mode, whether they are required and whether they are here.
  mount status                                 The mounts here that ask for attention: branch, commits ahead and behind, changes.
  mount park [<names>...]                      Park mounts: their clones go to _fx/~$parking/, never deleted.
  mount unpark [<names>...]                    Unpark mounts: a parked one comes back now; fx sync clones what is missing.
  mount pull [<names>...]                      Fast-forward the mounts here that have a clean working tree.
  mount add [<url>] [<path>]                   Add a mount to mounts.yaml, where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.
  mount remove [<name>]                        Take a mount out of mounts.yaml; its clone stays.
  mount tag [<name>] [<tags>...]               Add tags to a mount, or remove them (--remove).
  mount set [<name>] [<key>] [<values>...]     Change a key of a mount: url, path, required, mode, depends-on or inherits.
  mount rename [<name>] [<new-name>]           Rename a mount: its references in this space change, and the old name stays in aliases.
  worktree add <branch>                        Create a worktree of a branch in the nearest space (or --in), with where you are mounted in it.
  worktree mount <branch> <targets>...         Mount more of the tree in a worktree: repositories (with the
[truncated]

fx ui · the space in full screen (in a terminal; Ctrl+Q closes it)

Usage: fx <command> [options]

Space
  init                                         Make this folder a space: its _fx/space.yaml, with its name, and nothing more.
  sync [<module>]                              Generate and update what fx owns here and in everything mounted below, from the _fx configuration.
  doctor [<module>]                            Check, without changing anything, that what fx owns here and below is right.
  mount list                                   The mounts of mounts.yaml: where, their mode, whether they are required and whether they are here.
  mount status                                 The mounts here that ask for attention: branch, commits ahead and behind, changes.
  mount park [<names>...]                      Park mounts: their clones go to _fx/~$parking/, never deleted.
  mount unpark [<names>...]                    Unpark mounts: a parked one comes back now; fx sync clones what is missing.
  mount pull [<names>...]                      Fast-forward the mounts here that have a clean working tree.
  mount add [<url>] [<path>]                   Add a mount to mounts.yaml, where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.
  mount remove [<name>]                        Take a mount out of mounts.yaml; its clone stays.
  mount tag [<name>] [<tags>...]               Add tags to a mount, or remove them (--remove).
  mount set [<name>] [<key>] [<values>...]     Change a key of a mount: url, path, required, mode, depends-on or inherits.
  mount rename [<name>] [<new-name>]           Rename a mount: its references in this space change, and the old name stays in aliases.
  worktree add <branch>                        Create a worktree of a branch in the nearest space (or --in), with where you are mounted in it.
  worktree mount <branch> <targets>...         Mount more of the tree in a worktree: repositories (with the
[truncated]
